### Thread 1 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: 3 of the PR's 7 new widget tests fail on the committed lockfile**

Verified on the PR branch with the pinned toolchain (Flutter 3.47.6, `packages/fa_ui/pubspec.lock` → flutter_svg 2.3.0, unmodified working tree):

```
flutter test test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart
→ 4 passed, 3 failed
flutter test   (full fa_ui suite)
→ 564 passed, 3 failed   (all 3 failures are this file)
```

This helper matches **two** `SizedBox` widgets, so `tester.widget<SizedBox>(...)` throws `Bad state: Too many elements`:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    (tester.widget<SizedBox>(find.descendant(
      of: find.byType(KaomojiThinkingIcon),
      matching: find.byType(SizedBox),
    )).key! as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

flutter_svg 2.3.0 renders `SvgPicture.string` as `VectorGraphic → Semantics → FittedBox → SizedBox(24×24) → _RawPictureVectorGraphicWidget`, so the probe subtree under `KaomojiThinkingIcon` contains the keyed `SizedBox(16×16)` **plus** flutter_svg's internal `SizedBox(24×24)`. Both "thinking tile: … frozen" and "thinkingLive: … swaps" tests die in this helper.

Fix: match the key directly instead of the widget type — the existing keying makes this easy and immune to flutter_svg internals:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    ((tester.widget(find.byWidgetPredicate(
          (w) => w.key is ValueKey<KaomojiFace>,
        )).key!) as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

---

### Thread 2 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: status-row test crashes — `Text.rich` wraps the span, so `root().children![0].text` is null**

Third failing test (same run: `564 passed, 3 failed` in `packages/fa_ui` on the committed lockfile):

```
_NullTypeError was thrown: Null check operator used on a null value
#0  main.<anonymous closure>.shown (fa_kaomoji_test.dart:226)
```

`KaomojiFaceText` builds `Text.rich(TextSpan(children: [run spans…]))`. `Text.rich` does **not** use the given span as the `RichText` root — it nests it under a wrapper span (`RichText.text = TextSpan(text: null, children: [givenSpan])`). So:

- `root()` (the `RichText`'s root span) has `text == null` and exactly **one** child — `KaomojiFaceText`'s outer span, which also has `text == null`;
- `root().children![0]` is that outer span → `(span as TextSpan).text!` crashes.

The run spans the test wants are one level deeper: `root().children!.single.children`. Suggested fix:

```dart
List<TextSpan> runs() => [
  for (final span in (root().children!.single as TextSpan).children!)
    span as TextSpan,
];
String shown() => [for (final s in runs()) s.text!].join();
Set<Color> tones() => {for (final s in runs()) s.style!.color!};
```

(Kept the `containsAll({eye, mouth})` + "no color outside the brand palette" assertions — they're good.)

### Thread 3 — `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/chat_message_tile.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: `thinkingLive: isStreaming` animates EVERY thinking tile, not the live one**

The PR description promises: *"New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4)."* The wiring cannot deliver that: all three call sites (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1183`, `fa_chat_overlay.dart:321`, `session_chat_sheet.dart:1821`) pass the same `service.isStreaming` to **every** tile in the transcript.

Probe-confirmed on this branch (two `ChatMessageTile`s with `role: 'thinking'`, `thinkingLive: true`, one pump of 950 ms):

```
TILE0 >_o -> o_o changed=true    ← finished note
TILE1 ¬_¬ -> >_o changed=true    ← live note
```

Every `thinking` message in the visible transcript animates: its own `KaomojiSwapper`, its own `Ticker`, its own random picker, and a full `SvgPicture.string` re-parse every ~0.9 s. This is the common case, not an edge case — the service appends one thinking message per LLM turn (`agent_service_assistant.dart` resets `_currentThinkingMessage` after each turn), so a single agentic run leaves several finished thinking tiles on screen while `isStreaming` is still true, and long sessions keep dozens in the transcript. Finished notes visibly flicker (contradicting AC4 as stated in this PR), and N tickers × SVG re-parses run during every stream on mobile/web.

Fix direction: gate on the **live thinking message's identity**, not the global streaming flag — e.g. expose the streaming thinking message (id) from `FaChatService` and pass `thinkingLive: streaming && message.id == service.liveThinkingMessageId`, or compute "the newest `thinking`-role message while streaming" at each call site (both the overlay and the sheet already hold the `messages` list).

## PR Description

Completes the host rollout of the owner-approved v3 design: the CLI TUI shipped in #1376; this PR renders the SAME face set in the remaining hosts.

## Shared source (one definition, three renderers)

`lib/src/kaomoji_faces.dart` (pure Dart, only `dart:math`) now owns the approved spec verbatim: the 8 faces (`>_o` `-__` `o_o` `>_<` `o_<` `◕‿◕` `¬_¬` `o_o?` — asymmetric two-eye faces, ASCII fallbacks `^.^` `-_/`), the two-tone brand palette (eyes/strokes teal `#60d0d0`, mouth blue `#70a0e0`), the ~0.9 s random-swap cadence, the approved SVG sprite frames (1.45× content scale, stroke 1.4, `.t`/`.b` classes resolved to inline strokes for flutter_svg), the skip-over face picker (`KaomojiFacePicker`, seedable `Random`; a swap never repeats the showing face) and a `debugPin` fixture seam mirroring the CLI's `FA_KAOMOJI_FACE`. ## Hosts

1. **App thinking block** (was the head-with-gear `Icons.psychology_outlined`, everywhere): `KaomojiThinkingIcon` renders the SVG sprite frames at 16 px, swapping on a random pick every ~0.9 s while the block streams. New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4). Wired in `FaChatScreen`, `FaChatOverlay` and the session sheet (desktop/mobile/web — one widget).
2. **Web TUI / app status row** (the `Working…` analog, `FaRunStatusRow`): the stock spinner is replaced by `KaomojiFaceText` — the kaomoji as two-tone colored spans (teal eyes, blue mouth) in a fixed 4-cell zone, re-picked on the row's existing elapsed ticker (~0.9 s). No new timer anywhere: both hosts animate on Tickers, so the clock stops with the phase (AC4) and no test can end with a pending timer.

## Tests

- `test/kaomoji_faces_test.dart` (core): the 8 faces/ids in the issue order, ASCII fallbacks + mouth segmentation, palette consts, SVG frame invariants (24-grid, 1.45×, 1.4 stroke, both tones, no `class=`), seeded-picker replay determinism, never-repeat + in-range picks, full-coverage run, `debugPin` freeze/clamp, the `kaomojiNextFaceIndex` skip-over seam.
- `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart` (widget): swapper cadence math (replay twins, no swap before the boundary), `active: false` freeze + mid-run stop, thinking tile renders the sprite (head-with-gear gone) and freezes when the phase ends, live tile swaps on cadence, status row two-tone palette assertion + swap + face gone with the phase.

## Screenshots / manual verification (host-locked, regenerating needed)

Visual verification per host (16 px legibility on dark, AC3):

- **App thinking block**: open any session, send a message — the thinking tile's icon swaps faces ~every 0.9 s while thinking streams, freezes when done.
- **Status row (web TUI)**: the `Thinking… · Ns` row shows a two-tone face instead of the spinner, swapping on the same cadence.
- **CLI**: unchanged from #1376.

⚠️ Flutter goldens that captured the old spinner / head-with-gear (`chat/run_status_*`, the overlay + chat thinking frames) need a mac regeneration pass after eyeballing — `ensureGoldenFonts` now pins the face (`>_o`) so regenerated snapshots stay deterministic. Goldens are host-locked and not on the per-PR CI path.

Fixes #1374

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1419._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: 3 of the PR's 7 new widget tests fail on the committed lockfile**

Verified on the PR branch with the pinned toolchain (Flutter 3.47.6, `packages/fa_ui/pubspec.lock` → flutter_svg 2.3.0, unmodified working tree):

```
flutter test test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart
→ 4 passed, 3 failed
flutter test   (full fa_ui suite)
→ 564 passed, 3 failed   (all 3 failures are this file)
```

This helper matches **two** `SizedBox` widgets, so `tester.widget<SizedBox>(...)` throws `Bad state: Too many elements`:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    (tester.widget<SizedBox>(find.descendant(
      of: find.byType(KaomojiThinkingIcon),
      matching: find.byType(SizedBox),
    )).key! as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

flutter_svg 2.3.0 renders `SvgPicture.string` as `VectorGraphic → Semantics → FittedBox → SizedBox(24×24) → _RawPictureVectorGraphicWidget`, so the probe subtree under `KaomojiThinkingIcon` contains the keyed `SizedBox(16×16)` **plus** flutter_svg's internal `SizedBox(24×24)`. Both "thinking tile: … frozen" and "thinkingLive: … swaps" tests die in this helper.

Fix: match the key directly instead of the widget type — the existing keying makes this easy and immune to flutter_svg internals:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    ((tester.widget(find.byWidgetPredicate(
          (w) => w.key is ValueKey<KaomojiFace>,
        )).key!) as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

---

### Thread 2 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: status-row test crashes — `Text.rich` wraps the span, so `root().children![0].text` is null**

Third failing test (same run: `564 passed, 3 failed` in `packages/fa_ui` on the committed lockfile):

```
_NullTypeError was thrown: Null check operator used on a null value
#0  main.<anonymous closure>.shown (fa_kaomoji_test.dart:226)
```

`KaomojiFaceText` builds `Text.rich(TextSpan(children: [run spans…]))`. `Text.rich` does **not** use the given span as the `RichText` root — it nests it under a wrapper span (`RichText.text = TextSpan(text: null, children: [givenSpan])`). So:

- `root()` (the `RichText`'s root span) has `text == null` and exactly **one** child — `KaomojiFaceText`'s outer span, which also has `text == null`;
- `root().children![0]` is that outer span → `(span as TextSpan).text!` crashes.

The run spans the test wants are one level deeper: `root().children!.single.children`. Suggested fix:

```dart
List<TextSpan> runs() => [
  for (final span in (root().children!.single as TextSpan).children!)
    span as TextSpan,
];
String shown() => [for (final s in runs()) s.text!].join();
Set<Color> tones() => {for (final s in runs()) s.style!.color!};
```

(Kept the `containsAll({eye, mouth})` + "no color outside the brand palette" assertions — they're good.)

---

### Thread 3 — `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/chat_message_tile.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: `thinkingLive: isStreaming` animates EVERY thinking tile, not the live one**

The PR description promises: *"New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4)."* The wiring cannot deliver that: all three call sites (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1183`, `fa_chat_overlay.dart:321`, `session_chat_sheet.dart:1821`) pass the same `service.isStreaming` to **every** tile in the transcript.

Probe-confirmed on this branch (two `ChatMessageTile`s with `role: 'thinking'`, `thinkingLive: true`, one pump of 950 ms):

```
TILE0 >_o -> o_o changed=true    ← finished note
TILE1 ¬_¬ -> >_o changed=true    ← live note
```

Every `thinking` message in the visible transcript animates: its own `KaomojiSwapper`, its own `Ticker`, its own random picker, and a full `SvgPicture.string` re-parse every ~0.9 s. This is the common case, not an edge case — the service appends one thinking message per LLM turn (`agent_service_assistant.dart` resets `_currentThinkingMessage` after each turn), so a single agentic run leaves several finished thinking tiles on screen while `isStreaming` is still true, and long sessions keep dozens in the transcript. Finished notes visibly flicker (contradicting AC4 as stated in this PR), and N tickers × SVG re-parses run during every stream on mobile/web.

Fix direction: gate on the **live thinking message's identity**, not the global streaming flag — e.g. expose the streaming thinking message (id) from `FaChatService` and pass `thinkingLive: streaming && message.id == service.liveThinkingMessageId`, or compute "the newest `thinking`-role message while streaming" at each call site (both the overlay and the sheet already hold the `messages` list).

---

### Thread 4 — `flutter_app/test/golden/golden_test_helper.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: mandatory golden gate left red — changed visuals, snapshots not regenerated**

AGENTS.md ("Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work") requires for changed visuals: *"regenerate affected snapshots"*, *"Eyes on pixels … OPEN every changed PNG"*, and a green gate (`flutter test test/golden` + `scripts/check_goldens.py`, run by pre-commit). This PR changes the thinking-tile icon and the status-row indicator but ships with the old snapshots still committed — the PR description itself flags the pending "mac regeneration pass".

Committed PNGs that will pixel-mismatch after this PR:

- `flutter_app/test/golden/goldens/chat/run_status_empty_light.png`, `run_status_empty_dark.png`, `run_status_thinking_light.png`, `run_status_tool_light.png`, `run_status_tool_dark.png` — still show the stock `CircularProgressIndicator` in the status row

Actually SvgPicture.string caches pictures via `svg.cache`/PictureProvider with cache — `SvgPicture.string` creates `StringPicture` (a PictureProvider) which IS cached by the picture cache keyed by the string. ## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. # PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1419._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: 3 of the PR's 7 new widget tests fail on the committed lockfile**

Verified on the PR branch with the pinned toolchain (Flutter 3.47.6, `packages/fa_ui/pubspec.lock` → flutter_svg 2.3.0, unmodified working tree):

```
flutter test test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart
→ 4 passed, 3 failed
flutter test   (full fa_ui suite)
→ 564 passed, 3 failed   (all 3 failures are this file)
```

This helper matches **two** `SizedBox` widgets, so `tester.widget<SizedBox>(...)` throws `Bad state: Too many elements`:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    (tester.widget<SizedBox>(find.descendant(
      of: find.byType(KaomojiThinkingIcon),
      matching: find.byType(SizedBox),
    )).key! as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

flutter_svg 2.3.0 renders `SvgPicture.string` as `VectorGraphic → Semantics → FittedBox → SizedBox(24×24) → _RawPictureVectorGraphicWidget`, so the probe subtree under `KaomojiThinkingIcon` contains the keyed `SizedBox(16×16)` **plus** flutter_svg's internal `SizedBox(24×24)`. Both "thinking tile: … frozen" and "thinkingLive: … swaps" tests die in this helper.

Fix: match the key directly instead of the widget type — the existing keying makes this easy and immune to flutter_svg internals:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    ((tester.widget(find.byWidgetPredicate(
          (w) => w.key is ValueKey<KaomojiFace>,
        )).key!) as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

---

### Thread 2 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: status-row test crashes — `Text.rich` wraps the span, so `root().children![0].text` is null**

Third failing test (same run: `564 passed, 3 failed` in `packages/fa_ui` on the committed lockfile):

```
_NullTypeError was thrown: Null check operator used on a null value
#0  main.<anonymous closure>.shown (fa_kaomoji_test.dart:226)
```

`KaomojiFaceText` builds `Text.rich(TextSpan(children: [run spans…]))`. `Text.rich` does **not** use the given span as the `RichText` root — it nests it under a wrapper span (`RichText.text = TextSpan(text: null, children: [givenSpan])`). So:

- `root()` (the `RichText`'s root span) has `text == null` and exactly **one** child — `KaomojiFaceText`'s outer span, which also has `text == null`;
- `root().children![0]` is that outer span → `(span as TextSpan).text!` crashes.

The run spans the test wants are one level deeper: `root().children!.single.children`. Suggested fix:

```dart
List<TextSpan> runs() => [
  for (final span in (root().children!.single as TextSpan).children!)
    span as TextSpan,
];
String shown() => [for (final s in runs()) s.text!].join();
Set<Color> tones() => {for (final s in runs()) s.style!.color!};
```

(Kept the `containsAll({eye, mouth})` + "no color outside the brand palette" assertions — they're good.)

---

### Thread 3 — `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/chat_message_tile.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: `thinkingLive: isStreaming` animates EVERY thinking tile, not the live one**

The PR description promises: *"New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4)."* The wiring cannot deliver that: all three call sites (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1183`, `fa_chat_overlay.dart:321`, `session_chat_sheet.dart:1821`) pass the same `service.isStreaming` to **every** tile in the transcript.

Probe-confirmed on this branch (two `ChatMessageTile`s with `role: 'thinking'`, `thinkingLive: true`, one pump of 950 ms):

```
TILE0 >_o -> o_o changed=true    ← finished note
TILE1 ¬_¬ -> >_o changed=true    ← live note
```

Every `thinking` message in the visible transcript animates: its own `KaomojiSwapper`, its own `Ticker`, its own random picker, and a full `SvgPicture.string` re-parse every ~0.9 s. This is the common case, not an edge case — the service appends one thinking message per LLM turn (`agent_service_assistant.dart` resets `_currentThinkingMessage` after each turn), so a single agentic run leaves several finished thinking tiles on screen while `isStreaming` is still true, and long sessions keep dozens in the transcript. Finished notes visibly flicker (contradicting AC4 as stated in this PR), and N tickers × SVG re-parses run during every stream on mobile/web.

Fix direction: gate on the **live thinking message's identity**, not the global streaming flag — e.g. expose the streaming thinking message (id) from `FaChatService` and pass `thinkingLive: streaming && message.id == service.liveThinkingMessageId`, or compute "the newest `thinking`-role message while streaming" at each call site (both the overlay and the sheet already hold the `messages` list).

---

### Thread 4 — `flutter_app/test/golden/golden_test_helper.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: mandatory golden gate left red — changed visuals, snapshots not regenerated**

AGENTS.md ("Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work") requires for changed visuals: *"regenerate affected snapshots"*, *"Eyes on pixels … OPEN every changed PNG"*, and a green gate (`flutter test test/golden` + `scripts/check_goldens.py`, run by pre-commit). This PR changes the thinking-tile icon and the status-row indicator but ships with the old snapshots still committed — the PR description itself flags the pending "mac regeneration pass".

Committed PNGs that will pixel-mismatch after this PR:

- `flutter_app/test/golden/goldens/chat/run_status_empty_light.png`, `run_status_empty_dark.png`, `run_status_thinking_light.png`, `run_status_tool_light.png`, `run_status_tool_dark.png` — still show the stock `CircularProgressIndicator` in the status row

### Thread 5 — `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_kaomoji.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `KaomojiThinkingIcon.active` defaults to `true` — an exported widget that animates forever by default**

```dart

AC4's whole point (as this PR states it) is "an idle indicator never animates", yet the default is the one configuration that violates it: a future call site that forgets `active:` silently gets a `Ticker` + `setState` every ~0.9 s for the widget's entire lifetime. **`KaomojiSwapper` / `KaomojiThinkingIcon`:**
- `_KaomojiSwapperState._syncTicker()` sets `_lastSwap = Duration.zero` when starting the ticker. Note: `didUpdateWidget` only calls `_syncTicker` when `active` changed. OK.
- On `active: false` → ticker stopped; `_lastSwap` keeps its old value. When reactivated → `_lastSwap = Duration.zero` reset. OK.

There's no caching of parsed SVG pictures. flutter_svg has `SvgPicture.string` with a `remember`... Actually SvgPicture.string caches pictures via `svg.cache`/PictureProvider with cache — `SvgPicture.string` creates `StringPicture` (a PictureProvider) which IS cached by the picture cache keyed by the string. The string is identical per face (8 distinct), so the parse happens once per face per cache eviction. Hmm — actually flutter_svg caches decoded pictures in an LRU `svg.cache.ninePatch`... there's `PictureCache` for PictureInfo. So re-parse cost may be amortized. The previous review's claim "a full SvgPicture.string re-parse every ~0.9 s" — the widget is recreated but the picture provider cache should serve the same bytes → likely cached. blocks.text:
## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,

## PR Description

Completes the host rollout of the owner-approved v3 design: the CLI TUI shipped in #1376; this PR renders the SAME face set in the remaining hosts.

## Shared source (one definition, three renderers)

`lib/src/kaomoji_faces.dart` (pure Dart, only `dart:math`) now owns the approved spec verbatim: the 8 faces (`>_o` `-__` `o_o` `>_<` `o_<` `◕‿◕` `¬_¬` `o_o?` — asymmetric two-eye faces, ASCII fallbacks `^.^` `-_/`), the two-tone brand palette (eyes/strokes teal `#60d0d0`, mouth blue `#70a0e0`), the ~0.9 s random-swap cadence, the approved SVG sprite frames (1.45× content scale, stroke 1.4, `.t`/`.b` classes resolved to inline strokes for flutter_svg), the skip-over face picker (`KaomojiFacePicker`, seedable `Random`; a swap never repeats the showing face) and a `debugPin` fixture seam mirroring the CLI's `FA_KAOMOJI_FACE`. ## Hosts

1. **App thinking block** (was the head-with-gear `Icons.psychology_outlined`, everywhere): `KaomojiThinkingIcon` renders the SVG sprite frames at 16 px, swapping on a random pick every ~0.9 s while the block streams. New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4). Wired in `FaChatScreen`, `FaChatOverlay` and the session sheet (desktop/mobile/web — one widget).
2. **Web TUI / app status row** (the `Working…` analog, `FaRunStatusRow`): the stock spinner is replaced by `KaomojiFaceText` — the kaomoji as two-tone colored spans (teal eyes, blue mouth) in a fixed 4-cell zone, re-picked on the row's existing elapsed ticker (~0.9 s). No new timer anywhere: both hosts animate on Tickers, so the clock stops with the phase (AC4) and no test can end with a pending timer.

## Tests

- `test/kaomoji_faces_test.dart` (core): the 8 faces/ids in the issue order, ASCII fallbacks + mouth segmentation, palette consts, SVG frame invariants (24-grid, 1.45×, 1.4 stroke, both tones, no `class=`), seeded-picker replay determinism, never-repeat + in-range picks, full-coverage run, `debugPin` freeze/clamp, the `kaomojiNextFaceIndex` skip-over seam.

## Screenshots / manual verification (host-locked, regenerating needed)

Visual verification per host (16 px legibility on dark, AC3):

- **App thinking block**: open any session, send a message — the thinking tile's icon swaps faces ~every 0.9 s while thinking streams, freezes when done.

Goldens are host-locked and not on the per-PR CI path.

### Thread 1 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: 3 of the PR's 7 new widget tests fail on the committed lockfile**

Verified on the PR branch with the pinned toolchain (Flutter 3.47.6, `packages/fa_ui/pubspec.lock` → flutter_svg 2.3.0, unmodified working tree):

```
flutter test test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart
→ 4 passed, 3 failed
flutter test   (full fa_ui suite)
→ 564 passed, 3 failed   (all 3 failures are this file)
```

This helper matches **two** `SizedBox` widgets, so `tester.widget<SizedBox>(...)` throws `Bad state: Too many elements`:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    (tester.widget<SizedBox>(find.descendant(
      of: find.byType(KaomojiThinkingIcon),
      matching: find.byType(SizedBox),
    )).key! as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

flutter_svg 2.3.0 renders `SvgPicture.string` as `VectorGraphic → Semantics → FittedBox → SizedBox(24×24) → _RawPictureVectorGraphicWidget`, so the probe subtree under `KaomojiThinkingIcon` contains the keyed `SizedBox(16×16)` **plus** flutter_svg's internal `SizedBox(24×24)`. Both "thinking tile: … frozen" and "thinkingLive: … swaps" tests die in this helper.

Fix: match the key directly instead of the widget type — the existing keying makes this easy and immune to flutter_svg internals:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    ((tester.widget(find.byWidgetPredicate(
          (w) => w.key is ValueKey<KaomojiFace>,
        )).key!) as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

---

### Thread 2 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: status-row test crashes — `Text.rich` wraps the span, so `root().children![0].text` is null**

Third failing test (same run: `564 passed, 3 failed` in `packages/fa_ui` on the committed lockfile):

```
_NullTypeError was thrown: Null check operator used on a null value
#0  main.<anonymous closure>.shown (fa_kaomoji_test.dart:226)
```

`KaomojiFaceText` builds `Text.rich(TextSpan(children: [run spans…]))`. `Text.rich` does **not** use the given span as the `RichText` root — it nests it under a wrapper span (`RichText.text = TextSpan(text: null, children: [givenSpan])`). So:

- `root()` (the `RichText`'s root span) has `text == null` and exactly **one** child — `KaomojiFaceText`'s outer span, which also has `text == null`;
- `root().children![0]` is that outer span → `(span as TextSpan).text!` crashes.

The run spans the test wants are one level deeper: `root().children!.single.children`. Suggested fix:

```dart
List<TextSpan> runs() => [
  for (final span in (root().children!.single as TextSpan).children!)
    span as TextSpan,
];
String shown() => [for (final s in runs()) s.text!].join();
Set<Color> tones() => {for (final s in runs()) s.style!.color!};
```

(Kept the `containsAll({eye, mouth})` + "no color outside the brand palette" assertions — they're good.)

### Thread 3 — `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/chat_message_tile.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: `thinkingLive: isStreaming` animates EVERY thinking tile, not the live one**

The PR description promises: *"New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4)."* The wiring cannot deliver that: all three call sites (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1183`, `fa_chat_overlay.dart:321`, `session_chat_sheet.dart:1821`) pass the same `service.isStreaming` to **every** tile in the transcript.

Probe-confirmed on this branch (two `ChatMessageTile`s with `role: 'thinking'`, `thinkingLive: true`, one pump of 950 ms):

```
TILE0 >_o -> o_o changed=true    ← finished note
TILE1 ¬_¬ -> >_o changed=true    ← live note
```

Every `thinking` message in the visible transcript animates: its own `KaomojiSwapper`, its own `Ticker`, its own random picker, and a full `SvgPicture.string` re-parse every ~0.9 s. This is the common case, not an edge case — the service appends one thinking message per LLM turn (`agent_service_assistant.dart` resets `_currentThinkingMessage` after each turn), so a single agentic run leaves several finished thinking tiles on screen while `isStreaming` is still true, and long sessions keep dozens in the transcript. Finished notes visibly flicker (contradicting AC4 as stated in this PR), and N tickers × SVG re-parses run during every stream on mobile/web.

Fix direction: gate on the **live thinking message's identity**, not the global streaming flag — e.g. expose the streaming thinking message (id) from `FaChatService` and pass `thinkingLive: streaming && message.id == service.liveThinkingMessageId`, or compute "the newest `thinking`-role message while streaming" at each call site (both the overlay and the sheet already hold the `messages` list).

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,

Completes the host rollout of the owner-approved v3 design: the CLI TUI shipped in #1376; this PR renders the SAME face set in the remaining hosts.

## Shared source (one definition, three renderers)

`lib/src/kaomoji_faces.dart` (pure Dart, only `dart:math`) now owns the approved spec verbatim: the 8 faces (`>_o` `-__` `o_o` `>_<` `o_<` `◕‿◕` `¬_¬` `o_o?` — asymmetric two-eye faces, ASCII fallbacks `^.^` `-_/`), the two-tone brand palette (eyes/strokes teal `#60d0d0`, mouth blue `#70a0e0`), the ~0.9 s random-swap cadence, the approved SVG sprite frames (1.45× content scale, stroke 1.4, `.t`/`.b` classes resolved to inline strokes for flutter_svg), the skip-over face picker (`KaomojiFacePicker`, seedable `Random`; a swap never repeats the showing face) and a `debugPin` fixture seam mirroring the CLI's `FA_KAOMOJI_FACE`. Wired in `FaChatScreen`, `FaChatOverlay` and the session sheet (desktop/mobile/web — one widget).
2. **Web TUI / app status row** (the `Working…` analog, `FaRunStatusRow`): the stock spinner is replaced by `KaomojiFaceText` — the kaomoji as two-tone colored spans (teal eyes, blue mouth) in a fixed 4-cell zone, re-picked on the row's existing elapsed ticker (~0.9 s). - `test/kaomoji_faces_test.dart` (core): the 8 faces/ids in the issue order, ASCII fallbacks + mouth segmentation, palette consts, SVG frame invariants (24-grid, 1.45×, 1.4 stroke, both tones, no `class=`), seeded-picker replay determinism, never-repeat + in-range picks, full-coverage run, `debugPin` freeze/clamp, the `kaomojiNextFaceIndex` skip-over seam.

# PR Discussion History

### Thread 1 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: 3 of the PR's 7 new widget tests fail on the committed lockfile**

Verified on the PR branch with the pinned toolchain (Flutter 3.47.6, `packages/fa_ui/pubspec.lock` → flutter_svg 2.3.0, unmodified working tree):

```
flutter test test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart
→ 4 passed, 3 failed
flutter test   (full fa_ui suite)
→ 564 passed, 3 failed   (all 3 failures are this file)
```

This helper matches **two** `SizedBox` widgets, so `tester.widget<SizedBox>(...)` throws `Bad state: Too many elements`:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    (tester.widget<SizedBox>(find.descendant(
      of: find.byType(KaomojiThinkingIcon),
      matching: find.byType(SizedBox),
    )).key! as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

flutter_svg 2.3.0 renders `SvgPicture.string` as `VectorGraphic → Semantics → FittedBox → SizedBox(24×24) → _RawPictureVectorGraphicWidget`, so the probe subtree under `KaomojiThinkingIcon` contains the keyed `SizedBox(16×16)` **plus** flutter_svg's internal `SizedBox(24×24)`. Both "thinking tile: … frozen" and "thinkingLive: … swaps" tests die in this helper.

Fix: match the key directly instead of the widget type — the existing keying makes this easy and immune to flutter_svg internals:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    ((tester.widget(find.byWidgetPredicate(
          (w) => w.key is ValueKey<KaomojiFace>,
        )).key!) as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

---

### Thread 2 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: status-row test crashes — `Text.rich` wraps the span, so `root().children![0].text` is null**

Third failing test (same run: `564 passed, 3 failed` in `packages/fa_ui` on the committed lockfile):

```
_NullTypeError was thrown: Null check operator used on a null value
#0  main.<anonymous closure>.shown (fa_kaomoji_test.dart:226)
```

`KaomojiFaceText` builds `Text.rich(TextSpan(children: [run spans…]))`. `Text.rich` does **not** use the given span as the `RichText` root — it nests it under a wrapper span (`RichText.text = TextSpan(text: null, children: [givenSpan])`). So:

- `root()` (the `RichText`'s root span) has `text == null` and exactly **one** child — `KaomojiFaceText`'s outer span, which also has `text == null`;
- `root().children![0]` is that outer span → `(span as TextSpan).text!` crashes.

The run spans the test wants are one level deeper: `root().children!.single.children`. Suggested fix:

```dart
List<TextSpan> runs() => [
  for (final span in (root().children!.single as TextSpan).children!)
    span as TextSpan,
];
String shown() => [for (final s in runs()) s.text!].join();
Set<Color> tones() => {for (final s in runs()) s.style!.color!};
```

(Kept the `containsAll({eye, mouth})` + "no color outside the brand palette" assertions — they're good.)

---

### Thread 3 — `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/chat_message_tile.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: `thinkingLive: isStreaming` animates EVERY thinking tile, not the live one**

The PR description promises: *"New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4)."* The wiring cannot deliver that: all three call sites (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1183`, `fa_chat_overlay.dart:321`, `session_chat_sheet.dart:1821`) pass the same `service.isStreaming` to **every** tile in the transcript.

Probe-confirmed on this branch (two `ChatMessageTile`s with `role: 'thinking'`, `thinkingLive: true`, one pump of 950 ms):

```
TILE0 >_o -> o_o changed=true    ← finished note
TILE1 ¬_¬ -> >_o changed=true    ← live note
```

Every `thinking` message in the visible transcript animates: its own `KaomojiSwapper`, its own `Ticker`, its own random picker, and a full `SvgPicture.string` re-parse every ~0.9 s. This is the common case, not an edge case — the service appends one thinking message per LLM turn (`agent_service_assistant.dart` resets `_currentThinkingMessage` after each turn), so a single agentic run leaves several finished thinking tiles on screen while `isStreaming` is still true, and long sessions keep dozens in the transcript. Finished notes visibly flicker (contradicting AC4 as stated in this PR), and N tickers × SVG re-parses run during every stream on mobile/web.

Fix direction: gate on the **live thinking message's identity**, not the global streaming flag — e.g. expose the streaming thinking message (id) from `FaChatService` and pass `thinkingLive: streaming && message.id == service.liveThinkingMessageId`, or compute "the newest `thinking`-role message while streaming" at each call site (both the overlay and the sheet already hold the `messages` list).

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.

## PR Description

Completes the host rollout of the owner-approved v3 design: the CLI TUI shipped in #1376; this PR renders the SAME face set in the remaining hosts.

## Shared source (one definition, three renderers)

`lib/src/kaomoji_faces.dart` (pure Dart, only `dart:math`) now owns the approved spec verbatim: the 8 faces (`>_o` `-__` `o_o` `>_<` `o_<` `◕‿◕` `¬_¬` `o_o?` — asymmetric two-eye faces, ASCII fallbacks `^.^` `-_/`), the two-tone brand palette (eyes/strokes teal `#60d0d0`, mouth blue `#70a0e0`), the ~0.9 s random-swap cadence, the approved SVG sprite frames (1.45× content scale, stroke 1.4, `.t`/`.b` classes resolved to inline strokes for flutter_svg), the skip-over face picker (`KaomojiFacePicker`, seedable `Random`; a swap never repeats the showing face) and a `debugPin` fixture seam mirroring the CLI's `FA_KAOMOJI_FACE`. The CLI part file was slimmed to its TUI-side rendering and re-exports the shared names, so all #1376 behavior/tests are unchanged.

## Hosts

1. **App thinking block** (was the head-with-gear `Icons.psychology_outlined`, everywhere): `KaomojiThinkingIcon` renders the SVG sprite frames at 16 px, swapping on a random pick every ~0.9 s while the block streams. New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4). Wired in `FaChatScreen`, `FaChatOverlay` and the session sheet (desktop/mobile/web — one widget).
2. **Web TUI / app status row** (the `Working…` analog, `FaRunStatusRow`): the stock spinner is replaced by `KaomojiFaceText` — the kaomoji as two-tone colored spans (teal eyes, blue mouth) in a fixed 4-cell zone, re-picked on the row's existing elapsed ticker (~0.9 s). No new timer anywhere: both hosts animate on Tickers, so the clock stops with the phase (AC4) and no test can end with a pending timer.

## Tests

- `test/kaomoji_faces_test.dart` (core): the 8 faces/ids in the issue order, ASCII fallbacks + mouth segmentation, palette consts, SVG frame invariants (24-grid, 1.45×, 1.4 stroke, both tones, no `class=`), seeded-picker replay determinism, never-repeat + in-range picks, full-coverage run, `debugPin` freeze/clamp, the `kaomojiNextFaceIndex` skip-over seam.
- `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart` (widget): swapper cadence math (replay twins, no swap before the boundary), `active: false` freeze + mid-run stop, thinking tile renders the sprite (head-with-gear gone) and freezes when the phase ends, live tile swaps on cadence, status row two-tone palette assertion + swap + face gone with the phase.

## Screenshots / manual verification (host-locked, regenerating needed)

Visual verification per host (16 px legibility on dark, AC3):

- **App thinking block**: open any session, send a message — the thinking tile's icon swaps faces ~every 0.9 s while thinking streams, freezes when done.
- **Status row (web TUI)**: the `Thinking… · Ns` row shows a two-tone face instead of the spinner, swapping on the same cadence.
- **CLI**: unchanged from #1376.

⚠️ Flutter goldens that captured the old spinner / head-with-gear (`chat/run_status_*`, the overlay + chat thinking frames) need a mac regeneration pass after eyeballing — `ensureGoldenFonts` now pins the face (`>_o`) so regenerated snapshots stay deterministic. Goldens are host-locked and not on the per-PR CI path.

Fixes #1374

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1419._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: 3 of the PR's 7 new widget tests fail on the committed lockfile**

Verified on the PR branch with the pinned toolchain (Flutter 3.47.6, `packages/fa_ui/pubspec.lock` → flutter_svg 2.3.0, unmodified working tree):

```
flutter test test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart
→ 4 passed, 3 failed
flutter test   (full fa_ui suite)
→ 564 passed, 3 failed   (all 3 failures are this file)
```

This helper matches **two** `SizedBox` widgets, so `tester.widget<SizedBox>(...)` throws `Bad state: Too many elements`:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    (tester.widget<SizedBox>(find.descendant(
      of: find.byType(KaomojiThinkingIcon),
      matching: find.byType(SizedBox),
    )).key! as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

flutter_svg 2.3.0 renders `SvgPicture.string` as `VectorGraphic → Semantics → FittedBox → SizedBox(24×24) → _RawPictureVectorGraphicWidget`, so the probe subtree under `KaomojiThinkingIcon` contains the keyed `SizedBox(16×16)` **plus** flutter_svg's internal `SizedBox(24×24)`. Both "thinking tile: … frozen" and "thinkingLive: … swaps" tests die in this helper.

Fix: match the key directly instead of the widget type — the existing keying makes this easy and immune to flutter_svg internals:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    ((tester.widget(find.byWidgetPredicate(
          (w) => w.key is ValueKey<KaomojiFace>,
        )).key!) as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

---

### Thread 2 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: status-row test crashes — `Text.rich` wraps the span, so `root().children![0].text` is null**

Third failing test (same run: `564 passed, 3 failed` in `packages/fa_ui` on the committed lockfile):

```
_NullTypeError was thrown: Null check operator used on a null value
#0  main.<anonymous closure>.shown (fa_kaomoji_test.dart:226)
```

`KaomojiFaceText` builds `Text.rich(TextSpan(children: [run spans…]))`. `Text.rich` does **not** use the given span as the `RichText` root — it nests it under a wrapper span (`RichText.text = TextSpan(text: null, children: [givenSpan])`). So:

- `root()` (the `RichText`'s root span) has `text == null` and exactly **one** child — `KaomojiFaceText`'s outer span, which also has `text == null`;
- `root().children![0]` is that outer span → `(span as TextSpan).text!` crashes.

The run spans the test wants are one level deeper: `root().children!.single.children`. Suggested fix:

```dart
List<TextSpan> runs() => [
  for (final span in (root().children!.single as TextSpan).children!)
    span as TextSpan,
];
String shown() => [for (final s in runs()) s.text!].join();
Set<Color> tones() => {for (final s in runs()) s.style!.color!};
```

(Kept the `containsAll({eye, mouth})` + "no color outside the brand palette" assertions — they're good.)

### Thread 3 — `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/chat_message_tile.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: `thinkingLive: isStreaming` animates EVERY thinking tile, not the live one**

The PR description promises: *"New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4)."* The wiring cannot deliver that: all three call sites (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1183`, `fa_chat_overlay.dart:321`, `session_chat_sheet.dart:1821`) pass the same `service.isStreaming` to **every** tile in the transcript.

Probe-confirmed on this branch (two `ChatMessageTile`s with `role: 'thinking'`, `thinkingLive: true`, one pump of 950 ms):

```
TILE0 >_o -> o_o changed=true    ← finished note
TILE1 ¬_¬ -> >_o changed=true    ← live note
```

Every `thinking` message in the visible transcript animates: its own `KaomojiSwapper`, its own `Ticker`, its own random picker, and a full `SvgPicture.string` re-parse every ~0.9 s. This is the common case, not an edge case — the service appends one thinking message per LLM turn (`agent_service_assistant.dart` resets `_currentThinkingMessage` after each turn), so a single agentic run leaves several finished thinking tiles on screen while `isStreaming` is still true, and long sessions keep dozens in the transcript. Finished notes visibly flicker (contradicting AC4 as stated in this PR), and N tickers × SVG re-parses run during every stream on mobile/web.

Fix direction: gate on the **live thinking message's identity**, not the global streaming flag — e.g. expose the streaming thinking message (id) from `FaChatService` and pass `thinkingLive: streaming && message.id == service.liveThinkingMessageId`, or compute "the newest `thinking`-role message while streaming" at each call site (both the overlay and the sheet already hold the `messages` list).

The previous review already ran the full `test/cli` suite green on this same content. The content hasn't changed since. I could skip re-running, but a quick targeted run of `test/kaomoji_faces_test.dart` (core) would be good to confirm the core tests pass on this head.)
5. Check for any NEW findings in this pass that the previous review missed. Let me think hard about the code:

**`KaomojiSwapper` / `KaomojiThinkingIcon`:**
- `_KaomojiSwapperState._syncTicker()` sets `_lastSwap = Duration.zero` when starting the ticker. Note: `didUpdateWidget` only calls `_syncTicker` when `active` changed. OK.
- On `active: false` → ticker stopped; `_lastSwap` keeps its old value. When reactivated → `_lastSwap = Duration.zero` reset. OK.
- `KaomojiThinkingIcon` is a StatelessWidget wrapping KaomojiSwapper. When `active` flips false, the swapper's didUpdateWidget stops the ticker. Good.
- The `SizedBox.square(key: ValueKey<KaomojiFace>(face))` — keyed by face so the element is REPLACED when the face changes → SvgPicture re-created → full SVG re-parse every swap (noted in previous review thread 3 as part of the perf concern). There's no caching of parsed SVG pictures. flutter_svg has `SvgPicture.string` with a `remember`... Actually SvgPicture.string caches pictures via `svg.cache`/PictureProvider with cache — `SvgPicture.string` creates `StringPicture` (a PictureProvider) which IS cached by the picture cache keyed by the string. The string is identical per face (8 distinct), so the parse happens once per face per cache eviction. Hmm — actually flutter_svg caches decoded pictures in an LRU `svg.cache.ninePatch`... there's `PictureCache` for PictureInfo. So re-parse cost may be amortized. The previous review's claim "a full SvgPicture.string re-parse every ~0.9 s" — the widget is recreated but the picture provider cache should serve the same bytes → likely cached. I won't relitigate that detail; the flicker/multiple-animators concern stands regardless.

**`KaomojiFaceText`:**
- `Text.rich` with runs. `softWrap: false`, `overflow: TextOverflow.visible`, `maxLines: 1`. In a `SizedBox(width: 32)`. Text scaling overflow noted.
- `base.copyWith(color: ...)` overrides color — the `palette.dim` dead style (thread 7) still present.

**`FaRunStatusRow`:**
- `_face = kKaomojiFaces[0]` dead state (thread 8) still present.
- One more thing: `_facePicker` is `final KaomojiFacePicker()` — process-random seeded, no injection seam for tests. The widget test asserts "a swap never repeats the face" via `isNot(first)` — fine with random. But the widget test's determinism relies on random picks — could a random pick EQUAL the first face? No — `next()` never repeats. OK.
- `didUpdateWidget` handles service swap; `_restartClock` in build on phase change. Pre-existing pattern.
- The face picker is NOT re-seeded per phase — `_facePicker` lives across phases; fine.

**Core data (`kaomoji_faces.dart`):**
- `KaomojiFace.text` — `'>_o'.length` etc. all BMP. OK.
- `kaomojiNextFaceIndex` — correct skip-over.
- `KaomojiFacePicker.debugPin` — a static mutable global in production library code. It's `static int? debugPin` — never reset by anything in production; the golden helper sets it. Risk: if any production code path accidentally sets it... it's named debugPin, documented as fixture seam. Acceptable.
- `first()` does `_current = _draw(kKaomojiFaces.length)` — with pin: `pin.clamp(0, max - 1)` = clamp(0,7) → 99→7. OK.
- Hmm — one subtlety: `KaomojiFacePicker.next()` when `debugPin != null` returns `kKaomojiFaces[_current]` — but if `_current` is still -1 (next called before first), it calls first(). OK.
- `_stroked` uses `replaceAll('class="t"', ...)` — string-level SVG handling. The test asserts no `class=` remains. OK.
- The SVG string is built with plain concatenation — no injection risk (static content).

**`fa_tui.dart`:**
- `import '../kaomoji_faces.dart'; export '../kaomoji_faces.dart';` — the import AND export: `import` gives part files access; `export` re-exposes to importers of fa_tui.dart. Since fa_tui.dart is under `lib/src/cli/`, it's internal API — but `bin/fa.dart` probably imports it. Wait — does anything import fa_tui.dart that would now also get KaomojiFace names conflicting with an existing import? `KaomojiFace` was previously defined IN fa_tui_kaomoji.dart (part of fa_tui.dart), so fa_tui already exported these names before this PR. Now they come from the shared file instead. Same names → no new conflicts. OK.

- One subtle behavior change for the CLI: `kaomojiNextFaceIndex` is now the shared function; previously `_nextKaomojiIndex`. Identical logic. And `KaomojiFace` now has `id` and `svg` fields — the CLI's `_kaomojiPlainText`/`_kaomojiColored` use runsFor. Unchanged behavior.

**`lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart`:** exports `src/kaomoji_faces.dart` — new public API in the core package. Reasonable given fa_ui and flutter_app import it. OK.

**`test/kaomoji_faces_test.dart`:** imports `package:flutter_agent_harness/src/kaomoji_faces.dart` directly (internal path) while the public export exists — minor inconsistency; also imports `package:test/test.dart` — check the root package's dev_dependencies include `test`.

**Golden helper:** `KaomojiFacePicker.debugPin = 0` — sets pin BEFORE the `_fontsLoaded` early-return. Good. But it mutates global state for the whole golden test process — fine as goldens want it pinned. But note: goldens run in the same process as... only golden tests. OK.

However — there IS a real remaining issue with the golden approach beyond non-regeneration: the pin ensures determinism, but the committed goldens show the old spinner/gear — so `flutter test/golden` fails. That's blocker 4.

**New potential findings not in previous threads:**

a) `KaomojiSwapper._onTick`: when `widget.active` is false, the ticker is stopped so `_onTick` won't fire — OK.

b) `KaomojiThinkingIcon` doc says "(the tile stays on screen with [active] false — no timer)". OK.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in

   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames

   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.

## PR Description

Completes the host rollout of the owner-approved v3 design: the CLI TUI shipped in #1376; this PR renders the SAME face set in the remaining hosts.

## Shared source (one definition, three renderers)

`lib/src/kaomoji_faces.dart` (pure Dart, only `dart:math`) now owns the approved spec verbatim: the 8 faces (`>_o` `-__` `o_o` `>_<` `o_<` `◕‿◕` `¬_¬` `o_o?` — asymmetric two-eye faces, ASCII fallbacks `^.^` `-_/`), the two-tone brand palette (eyes/strokes teal `#60d0d0`, mouth blue `#70a0e0`), the ~0.9 s random-swap cadence, the approved SVG sprite frames (1.45× content scale, stroke 1.4, `.t`/`.b` classes resolved to inline strokes for flutter_svg), the skip-over face picker (`KaomojiFacePicker`, seedable `Random`; a swap never repeats the showing face) and a `debugPin` fixture seam mirroring the CLI's `FA_KAOMOJI_FACE`. Wired in `FaChatScreen`, `FaChatOverlay` and the session sheet (desktop/mobile/web — one widget).
2. **Web TUI / app status row** (the `Working…` analog, `FaRunStatusRow`): the stock spinner is replaced by `KaomojiFaceText` — the kaomoji as two-tone colored spans (teal eyes, blue mouth) in a fixed 4-cell zone, re-picked on the row's existing elapsed ticker (~0.9 s). No new timer anywhere: both hosts animate on Tickers, so the clock stops with the phase (AC4) and no test can end with a pending timer.

## Tests

- `test/kaomoji_faces_test.dart` (core): the 8 faces/ids in the issue order, ASCII fallbacks + mouth segmentation, palette consts, SVG frame invariants (24-grid, 1.45×, 1.4 stroke, both tones, no `class=`), seeded-picker replay determinism, never-repeat + in-range picks, full-coverage run, `debugPin` freeze/clamp, the `kaomojiNextFaceIndex` skip-over seam.
- `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart` (widget): swapper cadence math (replay twins, no swap before the boundary), `active: false` freeze + mid-run stop, thinking tile renders the sprite (head-with-gear gone) and freezes when the phase ends, live tile swaps on cadence, status row two-tone palette assertion + swap + face gone with the phase.

## Screenshots / manual verification (host-locked, regenerating needed)

Visual verification per host (16 px legibility on dark, AC3):

- **App thinking block**: open any session, send a message — the thinking tile's icon swaps faces ~every 0.9 s while thinking streams, freezes when done.
- **Status row (web TUI)**: the `Thinking… · Ns` row shows a two-tone face instead of the spinner, swapping on the same cadence.
- **CLI**: unchanged from #1376.

⚠️ Flutter goldens that captured the old spinner / head-with-gear (`chat/run_status_*`, the overlay + chat thinking frames) need a mac regeneration pass after eyeballing — `ensureGoldenFonts` now pins the face (`>_o`) so regenerated snapshots stay deterministic. Goldens are host-locked and not on the per-PR CI path.

Fixes #1374

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1419._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: 3 of the PR's 7 new widget tests fail on the committed lockfile**

Verified on the PR branch with the pinned toolchain (Flutter 3.47.6, `packages/fa_ui/pubspec.lock` → flutter_svg 2.3.0, unmodified working tree):

```
flutter test test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart
→ 4 passed, 3 failed
flutter test   (full fa_ui suite)
→ 564 passed, 3 failed   (all 3 failures are this file)
```

This helper matches **two** `SizedBox` widgets, so `tester.widget<SizedBox>(...)` throws `Bad state: Too many elements`:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    (tester.widget<SizedBox>(find.descendant(
      of: find.byType(KaomojiThinkingIcon),
      matching: find.byType(SizedBox),
    )).key! as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

flutter_svg 2.3.0 renders `SvgPicture.string` as `VectorGraphic → Semantics → FittedBox → SizedBox(24×24) → _RawPictureVectorGraphicWidget`, so the probe subtree under `KaomojiThinkingIcon` contains the keyed `SizedBox(16×16)` **plus** flutter_svg's internal `SizedBox(24×24)`. Both "thinking tile: … frozen" and "thinkingLive: … swaps" tests die in this helper.

Fix: match the key directly instead of the widget type — the existing keying makes this easy and immune to flutter_svg internals:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    ((tester.widget(find.byWidgetPredicate(
          (w) => w.key is ValueKey<KaomojiFace>,
        )).key!) as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

---

### Thread 2 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: status-row test crashes — `Text.rich` wraps the span, so `root().children![0].text` is null**

Third failing test (same run: `564 passed, 3 failed` in `packages/fa_ui` on the committed lockfile):

```
_NullTypeError was thrown: Null check operator used on a null value
#0  main.<anonymous closure>.shown (fa_kaomoji_test.dart:226)
```

`KaomojiFaceText` builds `Text.rich(TextSpan(children: [run spans…]))`. `Text.rich` does **not** use the given span as the `RichText` root — it nests it under a wrapper span (`RichText.text = TextSpan(text: null, children: [givenSpan])`). So:

- `root()` (the `RichText`'s root span) has `text == null` and exactly **one** child — `KaomojiFaceText`'s outer span, which also has `text == null`;
- `root().children![0]` is that outer span → `(span as TextSpan).text!` crashes.

The run spans the test wants are one level deeper: `root().children!.single.children`. Suggested fix:

```dart
List<TextSpan> runs() => [
  for (final span in (root().children!.single as TextSpan).children!)
    span as TextSpan,
];
String shown() => [for (final s in runs()) s.text!].join();
Set<Color> tones() => {for (final s in runs()) s.style!.color!};
```

(Kept the `containsAll({eye, mouth})` + "no color outside the brand palette" assertions — they're good.)

---

### Thread 3 — `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/chat_message_tile.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: `thinkingLive: isStreaming` animates EVERY thinking tile, not the live one**

The PR description promises: *"New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4)."* The wiring cannot deliver that: all three call sites (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1183`, `fa_chat_overlay.dart:321`, `session_chat_sheet.dart:1821`) pass the same `service.isStreaming` to **every** tile in the transcript.

Probe-confirmed on this branch (two `ChatMessageTile`s with `role: 'thinking'`, `thinkingLive: true`, one pump of 950 ms):

```
TILE0 >_o -> o_o changed=true    ← finished note
TILE1 ¬_¬ -> >_o changed=true    ← live note
```

Every `thinking` message in the visible transcript animates: its own `KaomojiSwapper`, its own `Ticker`, its own random picker, and a full `SvgPicture.string` re-parse every ~0.9 s. This is the common case, not an edge case — the service appends one thinking message per LLM turn (`agent_service_assistant.dart` resets `_currentThinkingMessage` after each turn), so a single agentic run leaves several finished thinking tiles on screen while `isStreaming` is still true, and long sessions keep dozens in the transcript. Finished notes visibly flicker (contradicting AC4 as stated in this PR), and N tickers × SVG re-parses run during every stream on mobile/web.

Fix direction: gate on the **live thinking message's identity**, not the global streaming flag — e.g. expose the streaming thinking message (id) from `FaChatService` and pass `thinkingLive: streaming && message.id == service.liveThinkingMessageId`, or compute "the newest `thinking`-role message while streaming" at each call site (both the overlay and the sheet already hold the `messages` list).

---

### Thread 4 — `flutter_app/test/golden/golden_test_helper.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: mandatory golden gate left red — changed visuals, snapshots not regenerated**

AGENTS.md ("Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work") requires for changed visuals: *"regenerate affected snapshots"*, *"Eyes on pixels … OPEN every changed PNG"*, and a green gate (`flutter test test/golden` + `scripts/check_goldens.py`, run by pre-commit). This PR changes the thinking-tile icon and the status-row indicator but ships with the old snapshots still committed — the PR description itself flags the pending "mac regeneration pass".

Committed PNGs that will pixel-mismatch after this PR:

- `flutter_app/test/golden/goldens/chat/run_status_empty_light.png`, `run_status_empty_dark.png`, `run_status_thinking_light.png`, `run_status_tool_light.png`, `run_status_tool_dark.png` — still show the stock `CircularProgressIndicator` in the status row

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them

## PR Description

Completes the host rollout of the owner-approved v3 design: the CLI TUI shipped in #1376; this PR renders the SAME face set in the remaining hosts.

## Shared source (one definition, three renderers)

`lib/src/kaomoji_faces.dart` (pure Dart, only `dart:math`) now owns the approved spec verbatim: the 8 faces (`>_o` `-__` `o_o` `>_<` `o_<` `◕‿◕` `¬_¬` `o_o?` — asymmetric two-eye faces, ASCII fallbacks `^.^` `-_/`), the two-tone brand palette (eyes/strokes teal `#60d0d0`, mouth blue `#70a0e0`), the ~0.9 s random-swap cadence, the approved SVG sprite frames (1.45× content scale, stroke 1.4, `.t`/`.b` classes resolved to inline strokes for flutter_svg), the skip-over face picker (`KaomojiFacePicker`, seedable `Random`; a swap never repeats the showing face) and a `debugPin` fixture seam mirroring the CLI's `FA_KAOMOJI_FACE`. The CLI part file was slimmed to its TUI-side rendering and re-exports the shared names, so all #1376 behavior/tests are unchanged.

## Hosts

1. **App thinking block** (was the head-with-gear `Icons.psychology_outlined`, everywhere): `KaomojiThinkingIcon` renders the SVG sprite frames at 16 px, swapping on a random pick every ~0.9 s while the block streams. New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4). Wired in `FaChatScreen`, `FaChatOverlay` and the session sheet (desktop/mobile/web — one widget).
2. **Web TUI / app status row** (the `Working…` analog, `FaRunStatusRow`): the stock spinner is replaced by `KaomojiFaceText` — the kaomoji as two-tone colored spans (teal eyes, blue mouth) in a fixed 4-cell zone, re-picked on the row's existing elapsed ticker (~0.9 s). No new timer anywhere: both hosts animate on Tickers, so the clock stops with the phase (AC4) and no test can end with a pending timer.

## Tests

- `test/kaomoji_faces_test.dart` (core): the 8 faces/ids in the issue order, ASCII fallbacks + mouth segmentation, palette consts, SVG frame invariants (24-grid, 1.45×, 1.4 stroke, both tones, no `class=`), seeded-picker replay determinism, never-repeat + in-range picks, full-coverage run, `debugPin` freeze/clamp, the `kaomojiNextFaceIndex` skip-over seam.
- `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart` (widget): swapper cadence math (replay twins, no swap before the boundary), `active: false` freeze + mid-run stop, thinking tile renders the sprite (head-with-gear gone) and freezes when the phase ends, live tile swaps on cadence, status row two-tone palette assertion + swap + face gone with the phase.

## Screenshots / manual verification (host-locked, regenerating needed)

Visual verification per host (16 px legibility on dark, AC3):

- **App thinking block**: open any session, send a message — the thinking tile's icon swaps faces ~every 0.9 s while thinking streams, freezes when done.
- **Status row (web TUI)**: the `Thinking… · Ns` row shows a two-tone face instead of the spinner, swapping on the same cadence.
- **CLI**: unchanged from #1376.

⚠️ Flutter goldens that captured the old spinner / head-with-gear (`chat/run_status_*`, the overlay + chat thinking frames) need a mac regeneration pass after eyeballing — `ensureGoldenFonts` now pins the face (`>_o`) so regenerated snapshots stay deterministic. Goldens are host-locked and not on the per-PR CI path.

Fixes #1374

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1419._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: 3 of the PR's 7 new widget tests fail on the committed lockfile**

Verified on the PR branch with the pinned toolchain (Flutter 3.47.6, `packages/fa_ui/pubspec.lock` → flutter_svg 2.3.0, unmodified working tree):

```
flutter test test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart
→ 4 passed, 3 failed
flutter test   (full fa_ui suite)
→ 564 passed, 3 failed   (all 3 failures are this file)
```

This helper matches **two** `SizedBox` widgets, so `tester.widget<SizedBox>(...)` throws `Bad state: Too many elements`:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    (tester.widget<SizedBox>(find.descendant(
      of: find.byType(KaomojiThinkingIcon),
      matching: find.byType(SizedBox),
    )).key! as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

flutter_svg 2.3.0 renders `SvgPicture.string` as `VectorGraphic → Semantics → FittedBox → SizedBox(24×24) → _RawPictureVectorGraphicWidget`, so the probe subtree under `KaomojiThinkingIcon` contains the keyed `SizedBox(16×16)` **plus** flutter_svg's internal `SizedBox(24×24)`. Both "thinking tile: … frozen" and "thinkingLive: … swaps" tests die in this helper.

Fix: match the key directly instead of the widget type — the existing keying makes this easy and immune to flutter_svg internals:

```dart
KaomojiFace _shownFace(WidgetTester tester) =>
    ((tester.widget(find.byWidgetPredicate(
          (w) => w.key is ValueKey<KaomojiFace>,
        )).key!) as ValueKey<KaomojiFace>)
        .value;
```

---

### Thread 2 — `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_kaomoji_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: status-row test crashes — `Text.rich` wraps the span, so `root().children![0].text` is null**

Third failing test (same run: `564 passed, 3 failed` in `packages/fa_ui` on the committed lockfile):

```
_NullTypeError was thrown: Null check operator used on a null value
#0  main.<anonymous closure>.shown (fa_kaomoji_test.dart:226)
```

`KaomojiFaceText` builds `Text.rich(TextSpan(children: [run spans…]))`. `Text.rich` does **not** use the given span as the `RichText` root — it nests it under a wrapper span (`RichText.text = TextSpan(text: null, children: [givenSpan])`). So:

- `root()` (the `RichText`'s root span) has `text == null` and exactly **one** child — `KaomojiFaceText`'s outer span, which also has `text == null`;
- `root().children![0]` is that outer span → `(span as TextSpan).text!` crashes.

The run spans the test wants are one level deeper: `root().children!.single.children`. Suggested fix:

```dart
List<TextSpan> runs() => [
  for (final span in (root().children!.single as TextSpan).children!)
    span as TextSpan,
];
String shown() => [for (final s in runs()) s.text!].join();
Set<Color> tones() => {for (final s in runs()) s.style!.color!};
```

(Kept the `containsAll({eye, mouth})` + "no color outside the brand palette" assertions — they're good.)

---

### Thread 3 — `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/chat_message_tile.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: `thinkingLive: isStreaming` animates EVERY thinking tile, not the live one**

The PR description promises: *"New `ChatMessageTile.thinkingLive` gates the animation to the LIVE streaming thinking row — finished thinking notes stay on screen with a frozen face (AC4)."* The wiring cannot deliver that: all three call sites (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1183`, `fa_chat_overlay.dart:321`, `session_chat_sheet.dart:1821`) pass the same `service.isStreaming` to **every** tile in the transcript.

Probe-confirmed on this branch (two `ChatMessageTile`s with `role: 'thinking'`, `thinkingLive: true`, one pump of 950 ms):

```
TILE0 >_o -> o_o changed=true    ← finished note
TILE1 ¬_¬ -> >_o changed=true    ← live note
```

Every `thinking` message in the visible transcript animates: its own `KaomojiSwapper`, its own `Ticker`, its own random picker, and a full `SvgPicture.string` re-parse every ~0.9 s. This is the common case, not an edge case — the service appends one thinking message per LLM turn (`agent_service_assistant.dart` resets `_currentThinkingMessage` after each turn), so a single agentic run leaves several finished thinking tiles on screen while `isStreaming` is still true, and long sessions keep dozens in the transcript. Finished notes visibly flicker (contradicting AC4 as stated in this PR), and N tickers × SVG re-parses run during every stream on mobile/web.

Fix direction: gate on the **live thinking message's identity**, not the global streaming flag — e.g. expose the streaming thinking message (id) from `FaChatService` and pass `thinkingLive: streaming && message.id == service.liveThinkingMessageId`, or compute "the newest `thinking`-role message while streaming" at each call site (both the overlay and the sheet already hold the `messages` list).

---

### Thread 4 — `flutter_app/test/golden/golden_test_helper.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
🚨 **BLOCKING: mandatory golden gate left red — changed visuals, snapshots not regenerated**

AGENTS.md ("Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work") requires for changed visuals: *"regenerate affected snapshots"*, *"Eyes on pixels … OPEN every changed PNG"*, and a green gate (`flutter test test/golden` + `scripts/check_goldens.py`, run by pre-commit). This PR changes the thinking-tile icon and the status-row indicator but ships with the old snapshots still committed — the PR description itself flags the pending "mac regeneration pass".

Committed PNGs that will pixel-mismatch after this PR:

- `flutter_app/test/golden/goldens/chat/run_status_empty_light.png`, `run_status_empty_dark.png`, `run_status_thinking_light.png`, `run_status_tool_light.png`, `run_status_tool_dark.png` — still show the stock `CircularProgressIndicator` in the status row
- `goldens/apps_fa_chat_overlay_streaming.png`, `apps_fa_chat_overlay_streaming_light.png` — streaming overlay frames with the old thinking tile
- the chat/apps golden frames containing thinking bubbles (`chat_golden_test.dart` collapsed-thinking section, `apps_golden_test.dart` thinking rows) — still show `Icons.psychology_outlined`

The `debugPin = 0` seam added in this file is exactly the right prep (every regenerated frame is deterministic `>_o`) — but the regeneration + eyeball pass itself must land **in this PR**, before merge, so the pre-commit golden gate is green for the next person who touches the tree.

---

### Thread 5 — `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_kaomoji.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `KaomojiThinkingIcon.active` defaults to `true` — an exported widget that animates forever by default**

```dart
const KaomojiThinkingIcon({
  super.key,
  this.size = 16,
  this.active = true,   // ← starts an endless swap Ticker unless the caller opts out
  this.random,
});
```

This widget is exported from the `fa_ui` public barrel. AC4's whole point (as this PR states it) is "an idle indicator never animates", yet the default is the one configuration that violates it: a future call site that forgets `active:` silently gets a `Ticker` + `setState` every ~0.9 s for the widget's entire lifetime. The only current caller passes the flag explicitly, so nothing breaks today — but the safe default for a self-animating widget is *frozen*, with animation opt-in (`this.active = false`). `KaomojiSwapper` can keep `active = true`; it's the raw primitive.

### Thread 6 — `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_kaomoji.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-08):
💡 **SUGGESTION: the fixed 32 px face zone overflows at larger text scales**

```dart

```

The CLI solves the same problem with the ASCII fallback set below `kKaomojiAsciiMinWidth`; here the zone is a hardcoded `SizedBox(width: 32)`. At the default `bodySmall` (12 px) the widest face `o_o?` fits (~26 px), but with a accessibility text scale of ~1.3+ the same glyphs exceed 32 px and — because `KaomojiFaceText` uses `overflow: TextOverflow.visible` — paint over the 8 px gutter and under the status label. ## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
